description: Implement concurrent quota reservations and replay-safe requests
scenario: Fresh service; avoid exposing the independent test values to the candidate.
requirements: POST /api/quotas accepts {resource,capacity} creates an immutable nonnegative capacity (201)
POST /api/reservations accepts {resource,units,key}; units positive; returns 201 with {accepted:true,remaining:int}
Same key + identical request returns the same successful result without decrementing again
Same key + different payload returns 409; insufficient quota returns 409 and never negative
GET /api/quotas/{resource} returns {resource,remaining}; simultaneous reservation requests never oversubscribe
language: Java 21; Spring Boot 4; durable database optional but atomicity mandatory
